description: Source code for the QuicheDataWriter class, implementing methods for writing various data types and variable-length integers with endianness considerations.

classes.name: QuicheDataWriter
classes.description: A class for serializing data into a buffer with support for endianness and variable-length encoding.

methods.name: WriteUInt8
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer with endianness conversion if needed.

methods.name: WriteUInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer with endianness conversion if needed.

methods.name: WriteUInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned integer with endianness conversion if needed.

methods.name: WriteBytesToUInt64
methods.description: Writes a specified number of bytes from a 64-bit integer, considering endianness.

methods.name: WriteStringPiece16
methods.description: Writes a string with a 16-bit length prefix.

methods.name: BeginWrite
methods.description: Prepares buffer space for writing a specified length.

methods.name: WritePadding
methods.description: Pads remaining buffer space with zeros.

methods.name: WritePaddingBytes
methods.description: Writes a specified number of zero bytes.

methods.name: WriteVarInt62
methods.description: Encodes a 64-bit integer as a 62-bit variable-length integer.

methods.name: WriteStringPieceVarInt62
methods.description: Writes a string with a varint62 length prefix.

methods.name: GetVarInt62Len
methods.description: Determines the length of a varint62 encoding for a given value.

methods.name: WriteVarInt62WithForcedLength
methods.description: Encodes a value as a varint62 with a specified length.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Advances write position by specified length.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the writer's state.
